verdict.rationale: Runway Dev publishes agent-readable docs: llms.txt, raw Markdown pages and an OpenAPI 3.1 spec, all confirmed by probes. The docs cover submitting a text-to-video request, polling GET /v1/tasks/{id} until SUCCEEDED or FAILED, and reading the realized credit cost from response metadata. The asset-fetch step is not explicitly described: no output URL or download field is cited, and no hands-on agent run confirms the loop works end to end. missing for 10: documented asset retrieval from a completed task, independent or hands-on verification of the full agent loop.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can run the full video loop from docs alone: submit the prompt, watch the job, fetch the asset, and report the cost

citations.quote: send a request to receive a task id, then poll `GET /v1/tasks/{id}` until the task reaches `SUCCEEDED` or `FAILED`.
The response metadata reports the model used and the realized cost in credits.
Every documentation page is also available as raw Markdown by appending `.md` to its path
